# Pages, trees and regions

A page is a row (slug, title, status, frame, SEO) plus a tree (`splash.tree/2`) of nodes. Header, footer, above and below are regions: their trees live on pages named `region-*`, and `region.read` gives their root ids. Every node edit is a `tree.commit` of `splash.ops/2` ops.

## tree.commit

Apply an invertible batch of splash.ops/2 ops to a page tree. Each op names its node by `id` (insert names `parentId` and `index`): `insert` { parentId, index, node }, `remove` { id }, `move` { id, parentId, index }, `set_props` { id, patch } (a patch of props; null removes one), `set_style` { id, scope, patch }, `set_meta` { id, anchor?, name?, meta?, visibleTo?, locked? }, `set_attrs` { id, patch }, `set_variant` { id, variant }, `set_theme` { id, theme }, `set_mixins` { id, mixins }, `set_visibility` { id, visibility }, `set_type` { id, type }, `set_override` { id, target, patch }; only `insert` carries a whole node with its `props`. A node's section anchor is the node field `anchor`, not a prop or meta key. In a set_style patch and in the styles.sheet of an inserted node, each declaration value may be a raw CSS string ("clamp(22px, 2.3vw, 34px)", "{color.text}" for a token) or { kind: "raw", css }; the server tokenizes it with the inspector's parser and refuses a value the style catalogue does not allow, at its path. The class is content.edit, but only a content-prop edit (a set_props of a content field) needs no more: every other op of the batch needs site.edit.

- permission `content.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `tree:{pageId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `ops` | ({ op: "insert", parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0, node: { meta?: …, styles?: …, variant?: …, theme?: …, visibility?: …, attrs?: …, id: …, kind: …, type: …, children: … } \| { meta?: …, styles?: …, variant?: …, theme?: …, visibility?: …, attrs?: …, id: …, slot?: …, name?: …, anchor?: …, locked?: …, pro… (full schema: discover_operations) | yes |

Output: { revision: integer ≥0, inverse: ({ op: "insert", parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0, node: { meta?: …, styles?: …, variant?: …, theme?: …, visibility?: …, attrs?: …, id: …, kind: …, type: …, children: … } \| { meta?: …, styles?: …, variant?: …, theme?: …, visibility?: …, attrs?: …, id: …, slot?: …, name… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","ops":[{"op":"insert","parentId":"root0000","index":0,"node":{"id":"hero0001","kind":"section","type":"section","anchor":"hero","name":"Opening section","styles":{"sheet":{"base":{"position":"sticky","top":"0","min-height":"100svh","max-width":"none","padding-inline":"0"}}},"children":[{"id":"claim001","kind":"primitive","type":"text","props":{"text":{"en-US":"Architecture for the places we live in"}},"styles":{"sheet":{"base":{"font-size":"clamp(22px, 2.3vw, 34px)","color":{"kind":"raw","css":"{color.text.accent}"}}}}}]}},{"op":"set_props","id":"claim001","patch":{"text":{"en-US":"Architecture for the places we live and work in"}}},{"op":"set_style","id":"claim001","scope":"bp:md","patch":{"margin-inline-start":"50%"}},{"op":"set_meta","id":"hero0001","anchor":"opening","name":"Opening"},{"op":"set_attrs","id":"claim001","patch":{"data-tone":"quiet"}},{"op":"set_variant","id":"button01","variant":["ghost"]},{"op":"move","id":"intro001","parentId":"hero0001","index":1},{"op":"remove","id":"old00001"}]}
```

> A text prop keeps its shape: a plain string is the same in every language; a map `{ "it": "…", "en-US": "…" }` holds one text per language. Change only the language asked.

> Style values may be tokens (`"{space.4}"`, `"{color.text.accent}"`) or raw CSS; use a token whenever one exists. Scopes are `base` and breakpoints such as `bp:md`; `null` removes a declaration.

> Inserted nodes need fresh 8-character ids (`[0-9a-z]{8}`) unique in the page. `set_props` never stores a value equal to the default (`I8.default_stored`).

> Findings in the answer cover the whole page: look at the ones whose `nodeId` you touched.

## content.importMarkdown

Replace the content of a richtext node with Markdown, in one language (the site's main one when `locale` is absent; the other languages keep theirs). It reads `#` headings at their level, paragraphs, nested lists, fenced code with its language, pipe tables (head row as header cells), `> **Note:** …` quotes as callouts (Note/Nota, Tip/Suggerimento, Warning/Pitfall/Attenzione/Avvertenza; other quotes stay quotes), `<kbd>` keys, links the rich text allows, `**bold**`, `*em*` and `code`. A picture `![alt](src)` must be in the site's media library, named `media:<id>` or by its file name; one that is not is refused (upload it first). A YAML front matter block is skipped. One undoable tree commit.

- permission `content.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `tree:{pageId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `nodeId` | nodeId | yes |
| `markdown` | string (max 400000) | yes |
| `locale` | string (min 2, max 35) |  |

Output: { revision: integer ≥0, inverse: ({ op: "insert", parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0, node: { meta?: …, styles?: …, variant?: …, theme?: …, visibility?: …, attrs?: …, id: …, kind: …, type: …, children: … } \| { meta?: …, styles?: …, variant?: …, theme?: …, visibility?: …, attrs?: …, id: …, slot?: …, name… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","nodeId":"text0001","locale":"en-US","markdown":"# Build a page\n\nPress <kbd>Esc</kbd> to select the container.\n\n> **Note:** Every change saves on its own.\n\n```bash\nyarn splash context\n```\n"}
```

> Pictures must already be in the media library (`media:<id>` or the file name).

## page.create

Create a page with an empty tree. `status` defaults to draft; a draft page stays out of the site publish, so pass `status: "published"` for a page the next publication.publish should serve. Fill the tree with tree.commit in the same batch: read the new root id with tree.read through a $ref to this operation's page.id. A section's anchor is the node field `anchor` in that tree, not a page field, `meta.anchor` or `props.anchor`. A `pageType: "dynamic"` page names a collection in `collectionKey` and is the detail page of its items: it answers `/<slug>/<item slug>` in each locale, and its tree binds the item. Page validation and ownership checks apply.

- permission `site.admin` (admin); class `transaction`; writes `pages`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `slug` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `title` | Record<string, string> | yes |
| `frame` | string |  |
| `dynamic` | boolean |  |
| `position` | integer ≥-9007199254740991 |  |

Output: { page: { slug: string (min 1), title: Record<string, string>, frame: string, dynamic: boolean, position: integer ≥-9007199254740991, parentId: string \| null, requireAuth: boolean, requiredRoles?: string (max 40)[] (≤50), meta: Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (… \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …)[] \| Record<string,… (full schema: discover_operations)

## page.setPassword

Protect a page with a password, change it, or remove it with `password: null`. A visitor sees the password form instead of the page until they enter it; members are asked too. The password is stored hashed and never answered: page answers say only `passwordProtected`. Like the other page fields it reaches the public site with the next publish. Run it alone in a batch: the input is redacted from the history and the audit log, and the change is not undone.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `pages`; **not undoable**: alone in its batch.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `password` | string (min 4, max 200) \| null | yes |

Output: { page: { slug: string (min 1), title: Record<string, string>, frame: string, dynamic: boolean, position: integer ≥-9007199254740991, parentId: string \| null, requireAuth: boolean, requiredRoles?: string (max 40)[] (≤50), meta: Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (… \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …)[] \| Record<string,… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","password":"press-preview-2026"}
```
